selling.note: The buyer agent rate is the amount offered to the agent who brings the buyer. You choose it with me before listing.

buying.note: Rebate is a share of the commission my brokerage receives on your purchase, paid by Right at Home Realty after closing. Your lender must be told about the rebate. Conditions are set out in the buyer representation agreement.
